title: Sort the Students by Their Kth Score
description:
You are given a matrix score of size m × n, where:

m represents the number of students
n represents the number of exams
score[i][j] is the score obtained by the i-th student in the j-th exam

All values in the matrix are distinct integers.

You are also given an integer k (0-indexed), representing a specific exam.

Task

Sort the students (i.e., the rows of the matrix) in descending order based on their scores in the k-th exam.

Return the sorted matrix.

Example 1

Input:
score = [[10,6,9,1],[7,5,11,2],[4,8,3,15]], k = 2

Output:
[[7,5,11,2],[10,6,9,1],[4,8,3,15]]

Explanation:

Student 1 scored 11 in exam 2 → highest → rank 1
Student 0 scored 9 → rank 2
Student 2 scored 3 → rank 3
Example 2

Input:
score = [[3,4],[5,6]], k = 0

Output:
[[5,6],[3,4]]

Explanation:

Student 1 scored 5 in exam 0 → highest → rank 1
Student 0 scored 3 → rank 2
Constraints
m == score.length
n == score[i].length
1 ≤ m, n ≤ 250
1 ≤ score[i][j] ≤ 100000
All elements in score are distinct
0 ≤ k < n
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
